_comment: Canonical date-layer settings captured in the 18 Aug 2026 discovery session (docs/discovery/2026-08-date-layer-editor-notes.md). Values verified against API snapshots of Taylorsville (hand-built reference), San Antonio (generator-made), and Brigham City (added live during the session). No secrets in this file.
default_variant_note: Editor opens on graphite (variant-specific design). Switch to a light swatch first to edit the default design, which propagates to all non-specific variants.
dark_group_detection: group carries the white temple SVG asset (never keyed by colorway names)

personalization.instructions: Please add a date (accepted format: Month DD, YYYY)
personalization.note: The sales_channel_properties personalisation block rides the UI duplicate, but the editor requires the personalization text layer to be re-created per draft via the Personalize panel.

selectors._comment: Top-level controls verified against the live editor DOM in the 18 Aug discovery session. Panel-internal, swatch, and position-panel selectors below were meant to be finalized during Task 5a's dry run, but that dry run could not reach the editor DOM at all: Playwright's connect_over_cdp() failed against the running Chrome with CDP error 'Browser.setDownloadBehavior: Browser context management is not supported' (Chrome rejects browser-context-management CDP calls unless launched with --enable-automation, which ensure_chrome() omits on purpose to dodge Printify's Cloudflare fingerprint check). See task-5-report.md for the full mechanism and evidence. Every selector below marked with a 'note' is an unverified best-effort placeholder pending a working connection in 5b; none were confirmed against a real DOM this session.

layer_toolbar_font_dropdown.note: font family dropdown in the selected-layer top toolbar; exact selector finalized in driver dry run

layer_toolbar_color_hex_input.note: hex field inside the color picker opened from the toolbar color control. Not verified: the dry run could not reach the DOM (see selectors._comment), and the task instructions also say not to open the color picker read-only even if the DOM were reachable, since opening it risks changing the current color. Confirm in 5b.

info_modal_close_button.name: Close
info_modal_close_button.note: closes the 'Important product information' modal that can cover the editor on open. Name guessed from the discovery notes' description ('close button, plus a Hide this info in the future checkbox'); not verified against the live DOM. Confirm in 5b.

existing_text_layer_marker.note: meant to detect the personalizable text layer (named 'Text' per the discovery notes) via the canvas chip or layers-list entry, for has_text_layer()'s idempotency guard. Not verified: a bare exact-text match risks false positives if other UI elements also read exactly 'Text'. Confirm a more specific, scoped selector in 5b (e.g. within a layers-list container).

variant_swatch_group.note: meant to select the ordered list of color swatches in the 'Variants and layers' panel, so _select_group() can click swatches.nth(group['index']). This is a placeholder, not a verified selector; the dry run could not reach the DOM. In 5b: open that panel, inspect the swatch row markup, and replace this with a selector scoped to just the swatch buttons in their displayed order. The discovery notes also describe a 'blue dot' marker on variant-specific (dark) swatches as an alternative way to detect darkness directly from the DOM instead of trusting the caller-supplied index; worth checking if index-order clicking proves unreliable.

text_input.note: meant to type the placeholder date text into the newly created personalization layer. The discovery notes mention a character counter (18/1024) on this layer, which implies a real fillable input/textarea rather than pure canvas rendering, but the exact element was not located (dry run could not reach the DOM). Confirm in 5b.

layer_toolbar_color_button.note: meant to open the color picker from the selected layer's floating toolbar (before typing into layer_toolbar_color_hex_input). Not verified, and per the task instructions this control should not be clicked read-only even once reachable, since opening the picker risks changing the current color. Confirm in 5b.

width_input.label: Width
width_input.note: Position panel field. Label text guessed from the discovery notes ('Width 7 in'); not verified against the live DOM. Confirm exact label text in 5b.

height_input.label: Height
height_input.note: Position panel field. Label text guessed from the discovery notes ('Height 0.91 in'); not verified. Confirm in 5b.

position_left_input.label: Position left
position_left_input.note: Position panel field. Label text guessed from the discovery notes ('Position left 26.64 %'); not verified. Confirm exact label text in 5b (may be 'Left' rather than 'Position left').

position_top_input.label: Position top
position_top_input.note: Position panel field. Label text guessed from the discovery notes ('Position top 80.05 %'); not verified. Confirm exact label text in 5b (may be 'Top' rather than 'Position top').
